verdict.rationale: Mem0 ships official pip/npm SDKs (mem0ai) confirmed by runtime probes, a documented REST/OpenAPI spec, an official CLI, and an official MCP server, plus integration docs for 22+ frameworks (LangChain, CrewAI, LlamaIndex, Vercel AI SDK). Runtime probes independently verify the CLI and SDK install/run as documented. missing for 10: independent (non-vendor) hands-on review of the SDKs themselves beyond CLI/package install checks.
